subject: [PATCH 1/2] mm: page_alloc: do not give all non-blocking requests reserve access

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch corrects a previous change that granted all non-blocking memory allocation requests access to high-priority reserves. The original change improved atomic request success rates but inadvertently allowed unnecessary depletion of these reserves, which could worsen the performance of high-priority requests. To address this issue, the patch narrows the exemption to only allow GFP_ATOMIC allocations with both ALLOC_NON_BLOCK and ALLOC_MIN_RESERVE flags set, ensuring that other non-blocking requests do not deplete the reserves unnecessarily.
